An oscillation circuit provides clock signals and a clock distribution circuit or system of circuits having low skew and low jitter to logic circuits and memory circuits of a microprocessor or the like. Further, a semiconductor integrated circuit device of high speed is provided as a result of the stable clock signal that is generated and distributed. The oscillation circuit is in a semiconductor integrated circuit device having a plurality of oscillators each having an oscillation node, wherein the oscillation nodes of each of the oscillators are connected together by a conductive wiring line that may be a closed loop. The oscillators are synchronized to oscillate at substantially the same frequency. The oscillators are connected to the conductive wiring line at connecting points having substantially the same interval of conductive wiring lengths between the connection points, which leads to synchronizing the oscillators to oscillate with a substantially identical phase. The conductive wiring line can also be formed in the shape of a mesh with the interval of length of the conductive wiring line between the connection points being at least 50 mum. The oscillators are ring oscillation circuits having inverters connected in a ring shape wherein an output of at least one inverter of each ring oscillation circuit is connected to the conductive wiring. Alternatively, the oscillators may be delay lines having multistage connected inverters with at least one inverter connected to the conductive wiring line.

Summary of the invention

The objective of the invention is by means of oscillatory circuit being provided and comprising that the conductor integrated circuit device of the interconnection system that adopts this oscillatory circuit solves the problems referred to above.

Realize a kind of conductor integrated circuit device of the present invention, comprising: a plurality of circuit blocks; A plurality of annular oscillation circuits, each annular oscillation circuit all have the vibration node and produce oscillator signal; And the conducting wiring with a plurality of output nodes, wherein, described vibration node is connected to described conducting wiring at a plurality of tie points place, and described tie point spacing each other is the length of described conducting wiring between the described tie point; And wherein, described annular oscillation circuit offers each described circuit block with described oscillator signal as clock signal by each described output node.

According to the present invention, each annular oscillation circuit is in essentially identical frequency and/or the vibration of essentially identical phase-locking.

According to the present invention, conducting wiring wherein is prepared into the loop shape.

In most preferred embodiment of the present invention, conducting wiring is prepared into latticed, and the vibration node of annular oscillation circuit is connected on the point of crossing of grid, and wherein the gap length of conducting wiring equates basically.Gap length preferably is at least 50 μ m.

Realize another kind of conductor integrated circuit device of the present invention, comprising: a plurality of circuit blocks; A plurality of annular oscillation circuits, each annular oscillation circuit all have the phase inverter of the annular of connecting into and produce oscillator signal; And conducting wiring with a plurality of nodes, wherein, the output of at least one phase inverter is connected to described conducting wiring at a plurality of tie points place in each described annular oscillation circuit, and described tie point spacing each other is the length of described conducting wiring between the described tie point; And wherein, described annular oscillation circuit offers each described circuit block with described oscillator signal as clock signal by each described node.

Realize another conductor integrated circuit device of the present invention, comprising: a plurality of circuit blocks; A plurality of lag lines, each lag line all have the phase inverter of multistage connection and the clock signal that is transfused to; And the conducting wiring with a plurality of nodes, wherein, the output of at least one phase inverter is connected to described conducting wiring at a plurality of tie points place in each described lag line, and described tie point spacing each other is the length of described conducting wiring between the described tie point; And wherein, offer each described circuit block by each described node by the described clock signal after the described lag line delay.

Realize another conductor integrated circuit device of the present invention, it comprises: a plurality of circuit blocks that have clock distribution circuit; A plurality of annular oscillation circuits, respectively have a vibration node and from described vibration node clock signal to described clock distribution circuit; And the conducting wiring that connects the described vibration node of described each annular oscillation circuit at a plurality of tie points place jointly, described tie point spacing each other is the length of described conducting wiring between the described tie point.
